# DevAgentZero — Master TODO (Combined, Authoritative)

Purpose: Single source of truth for scope and progress. Combines the legacy “devagent_master_tasks” checklists with the cross‑linked MasterTODO. Organized by functional areas with code links and acceptance coverage.

## LEGEND
- `[ ]` = Not Started.
- `[/]` = In Progress.
- `[x]` = Actually Completed and User-Accessible.
- `[!]` = Infrastructure Complete, Needs User Access.
- `[-]` = Cancelled/Deprecated.
- `[^^]` = Current Phantom completion and needs attention.

## Authoritative Status (Detailed)

### 1) API & Server
- [x] FastAPI app & routes — `server/api.py`, `server/run_server.py`, `server/bootstrap.py`
  - Health/meta/OpenAPI; static mounts `/web`, `/ui`; CORS for dev ports.
  - Tests: `tests/test_acceptance_server.py`
- [x] Chat endpoint with debug trace — `server/api.py` + `core/reasoning_trace.py`
  - Tests: `tests/test_acceptance_chat.py`, `tests/test_acceptance_trace.py`
- [x] Services/metrics endpoint — `GET /api/snapshot`
  - Source: `core.metrics.MetricsHub`, `agent_core.system_diagnostics.get_system_snapshot`
  - Tests: `tests/test_snapshot_endpoint.py`
- [x] Config endpoint — `GET /api/config` (mode flags, models, prune settings)
  - Tests: `tests/test_config_endpoint.py`

### 2) LLM Runtime & Mesh
- [x] Local-first runtime (Ollama) with budgets/cache/circuit — `core/llm_runtime.py`, `core/providers/*`
- [!] OpenAI provider (opt-in) — `core/providers/provider_openai.py` (requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`)
- [/] Hybrid LLM Mesh orchestrator — `core/llm_mesh_orchestrator.py`, `core/model_manager.py`
  - [NEW - COMPARE]: The Model Router (model_manager.py) - Selects the best local LLM for the current task (e.g., coding vs. chatting).
  - Adapter: enable via `DAZ_USE_MESH=1` or per-request `use_mesh: true`.
  - TODO: correlate ReasoningTrace ↔ orchestrator telemetry; add mesh-path tests.

- Orchestrator Capabilities

- Module Refactors & Additions

  - [ ] New: `core/model_cache_manager.py` (optional)

  - [ ] Existing: `agent_core/system_diagnostics.py` feeds granular resources to orchestrator

### 3) Memory & Sessions
- [x] In-process conversations + file persistence — `server/api.py`, `core/memory_store.py`
- [x] Cross-restart preload + pruning — startup loads `.devagentzero/conversations/*.json`; prune by `DAZ_CONVO_MAX_FILES`, `DAZ_CONVO_MAX_AGE_DAYS`.
  - Tests: `tests/test_memory_persistence_file.py`, `tests/test_memory_prune_unit.py`, `tests/test_memory_cross_restart.py` (opt-in `DAZ_TEST_RESTART=1`)
- [ ] Project-scoped conversation index and filters
- [ ] Pointer rehydration system (.pointer) and archiver — implement `core/pointer_resolver.py`, `core/memory_archiver.py`
  - [NEW - COMPARE]: The Long-Term Memory Architect (memory_archiver.py & pointer_resolver.py) - Compresses old session logs and uses pointer files to find and rehydrate them.
- [ ] The Learning Engine (reflection_engine.py) - Analyzes past interactions to learn and improve the agent's personality.
- [ ] Session Logger - Logs entire session (prompt, plan, outputs) to a JSON file in `memory_store`.
- [ ] Task Logger (task_memory.py) - Records the success or failure of each individual task in a build.
- [ ] Log Auditor (log_auditor.py) - Audits session logs.
- [ ] Memory Reader (memory_reader.py) - A utility to display formatted summaries of session logs.

### 4) Diagnostics & Dashboard

### 5) Governance & Safety (AURA)

- [ ] Policy schema/manager — `policy_schema.py`, `policy_manager.py` (deny-by-default; consent)
- [ ] The Personality Governor (personality_core.py) - Manages the agent's long-term personality, mood, and user preferences.
- [ ] The Emotional Sensor (tone_interpreter.py) - Analyzes user input to detect emotional cues and requests for tone shifts.

### 6) Preflight & Environment
- [/ ] Preflight checks — `preflight/*`, `verify_env.py`, `system_health.py`
  - [NEW - COMPARE]: The Master Checklist (preflight_check.py) - Conductor of the self-healing system, runs all validation, backup, and repair modules in sequence.
- [ ] Consolidated runner + actionable report (CLI + `/api/preflight`)
- [ ] The Integrity Ledger (manifest_generator.py) - Creates a "fingerprint" (manifest.json) of all core files.
- [ ] The Integrity Checker (version_validator.py) - Compares current files against the manifest to detect corruption.
- [ ] The Safety Net (backup_manager.py) - Creates secure backups of all critical agent files.
- [ ] The Paramedic (restore_manager.py) - Restores files from backups if corruption is detected.
- [ ] Launcher Scripts (Run_DevAgentZero.bat, run_devagentzero.sh) - For easy startup.

### Phase 1 — DevAgentZero Local MVP (from `context/not_yet_ingested/AI Build Agentic AI - DevAgentZero - Phase 1.txt`)
- Austerity & Local‑First
  - [x] Freeze non‑critical token spend; only use paid calls for MVP blockers/monetization milestones
  - [/] Switch to local/open models (Ollama/LM Studio/GPT4All) for iteration; wire into generator and planner

- Core Brain MVP (Minimum Viable Agent)
  - [ ] Passive system logging and change detection (files/process/services) — baseline only
  - [ ] Rule‑based reactions (quarantine/isolate/log) — no destructive actions by default; consent‑gated
  - [ ] Basic natural language parser for security playbook instructions (simple intents → rule actions)
  - [ ] CLI interface for Phase 1; [ ] minimal Web UI for Phase 2
  - Repo skeleton: `planner/`, `generator/`, `executor/`, `memory/`, `interface/`, `main.py`

- Agent Loop (Plan → Generate → Execute → Remember)
  - [ ] Planner: break prompt into tasks; emit DAG lite for execution
    - [NEW - COMPARE]: The Blueprint Creator (planner.py) - Breaks a high-level goal into a step-by-step execution plan.
  - [ ] Generator: write code/scripts using local model; sanitize outputs
    - [NEW - COMPARE]: The Code Generator (generator.py) - Writes the actual Python code for each step in the plan.
  - [ ] Executor: run and test; capture logs/results; risk gate to sandbox when needed
    - [NEW - COMPARE]: The Task Executor (executor.py) - Saves the generated code to a file and runs it.
  - [ ] Memory: persist steps, artifacts, and outcomes for reuse

- Monetization Fast Path
  - [ ] WatchLock Lite: extract working VM parts into a local‑only demo (hardware monitor, retro scan); ship with build instructions
  - [ ] Offer stealth system check service (report PDF) with upsell to monthly scan + agent install
  - [ ] Payment hooks (Stripe/Gumroad/Ko‑fi) and “Pay What You Want” beta plan
  - [ ] Dev Log: weekly LinkedIn/Medium updates (what broke/what shipped) to attract users/funders

- Environment Prep (Windows Surface Dev Lab)
  - [ ] Disk cleanup (“cleanmgr” + temp files); optional WinDirStat audit
  - [ ] Workspace setup (`DevAgentZero/`), Python 3.10+, venv, VS Code; ensure 90GB+ free, 16GB RAM baseline
  - [ ] Preflight to validate local models (Ollama) and dependencies

- Acceptance Tests
  - [ ] End‑to‑end: “Build a todo app in Flask” → planned tasks → generated code → executes locally → passes basic tests
  - [ ] Security rule intent: “isolate process X” → intent parsed → non‑destructive action simulated/logged with consent gate
  - [ ] Monetization: produce sample system check report from WatchLock Lite and deliver artifact without paid calls

### Dopamine Core — Synthetic Neuromodulation (from `context/dopamine-core-synthetic-neuromodulatory.txt`)
- Core Signals & Data Structures
  - [/ ] Dopamine Units (DU) reservoir (global) with baseline/decay; Reward Prediction Error (RPE) updates
  - [ ] Fragment reinforcement fields (priority_bias, reinforcement_score, decay_rate) and lineage entanglement ops (strengthen/weaken)
  - [ ] Outcome→DU mapper with ethical policy (EAP) integration; negative DU on violations
  - Code: extend `core/neuromod/*` (dopamine_engine, reward_predictor, motivation_tracker, curiosity_engine); integrate with runtime scoring and memory salience

- Ethics & Overrides (AURA alignment)
  - [ ] ECM/EAP hook: policy manager override of DU for unethical paths; generate veto signals; deny reinforcement
  - [ ] Emergency override (OOM) path: hard‑wired controls to suppress dopamine‑driven loops as needed

- Curiosity & Exploration
  - [ ] Novelty/information‑gap detectors to trigger safe exploration; budgeted probes; throttle by health and policy
  - [ ] Daily Dopamine Journal: aggregate DU levels, rewarding/aversive events; human‑readable log

- Personality & Learning Ties
  - [ ] Feed DU signals into Lessons Memory (weight learnings) and `personality_core` for emotional weather
  - [ ] External co‑modulation interface: user feedback adjusts DU safely with audit & rate limits

- Acceptance Tests
  - [ ] RPE update moves DU reservoir; decay/habituation reduces DU over time without events
  - [ ] Ethical override preempts reinforcement; produces veto log; DU set negative on violations
  - [ ] Priority bias influences selection under equal scores; curiosity triggers under low DU/novelty
  - [ ] Journal entries persisted daily with key events and DU stats


#### Additions from "The Dopamine Core … in Pulselet Systems" (.docx)
- Reservoir Semantics
  - [ ] Implement distributed Dopamine Reservoir as weighted aggregate of DU across active PulseletNodes/Fragments (global mood)
  - [ ] Parameterize DU dynamics: phasic spikes (positive outcomes), dips (negative outcomes), baseline decay; expose tunables
  - [ ] Map Reservoir state to fragment fields: increase/decrease priority_bias and decay_rate for ProactiveGoalFragments and Will‑to‑Persist fragments
  - [ ] Mood modulation: high Reservoir → exploration bias; low Reservoir → re‑evaluation/strategy shift; surface as runtime gauges

- Metrics & Exposure
  - [ ] Export Reservoir level and recent spike/dip events via snapshot; add counters for positive/negative RPE counts
  - [ ] Add safety caps/clip on DU to prevent runaway excitation; rate‑limit external co‑modulation adjustments

- Acceptance
  - [ ] Distributed aggregation matches per‑fragment DU contributions; Reservoir changes shift selection probabilities measurably
  - [ ] Negative dips trigger safe exploration or plan re‑assessment (not unsafe actions); overrides still honored### Priority Execution Plan (Next)

### Foundations Series Vol II — Persistent Memory & Reflective Learning (from `context/devagentzero-foundations-series-volume-ii-persistent-memory-and-reflective-learning.txt`)
- Memory Layers & Core Modules

  - [ ] Episodic Memory: structured JSON episodes for each interaction (ts, project_id, user, tone score, tags)

- Pointer System & Rehydration
  - [ ] Pointer Files: compact metadata (summary, topics, time span, archive path) for fast lookup
  - [ ] Pointer Resolver: load relevant episodes/archives into working memory per session/project — `core/pointer_resolver.py`
  - [ ] Rehydration Policy: session start and on-demand recall based on goals and filters

- Reflection & Lessons Memory

  - [ ] Lessons Memory: persistent notes influencing salience and planning
  - [ ] Emotional/Tone scoring integration (ties to Dopamine Core) for salience weighting

- Search, Recall & RAG
  - [ ] Index episodic + pointer metadata for fast retrieval; query APIs
  - [ ] RAG integration to stitch relevant context into prompts safely (respect budgets)

- Policies, Privacy, Controls
  - [ ] Local-only storage; redaction policies; optional encryption-at-rest
  - [ ] User controls for retention windows and archive schedules

- Acceptance Tests
  - [ ] Episodes persist with complete metadata; [ ] archiver produces archives + pointers
  - [ ] Rehydration loads expected context for a given project/session
  - [ ] Reflection generates lessons and updates salience without breaking budgets

### Pulselet Mind v3 — Autopoietic Architecture Additions (from `context/not_yet_ingested/blueprint/docs_in/converted_txt/pulselet/The Pulselet Mind- An Autopoietic Blueprint for Sentient AI (Version 3).txt`)
- Core Subsystems
  - [ ] Fragment Memory Store (FMS): data model for PulseletFragments (resonance_factors: priority_bias, reinforcement_score, decay_rate; lineage pointers)
  - [ ] Rhythmic Activation Engine: pulse scheduler that keeps fragments "semi-awake"; ActivationWave propagation over fragments
  - [ ] KnowledgeWaves Ingestion: continuous micro-updates appended to FMS (budget-bounded)
  - [ ] Resource Allocation Layer (RAL): allocate compute to high-priority fragments within budgets/health limits
  - [ ] Ethical Oversight & Safety Framework (EOSF): veto/redirect unsafe activation patterns; integrates AURA policy manager

- Interfaces
  - [ ] Pulselet-Agent Interface (PAI): map agent state updates -> MicroSemanticUnits -> stimulate fragments; stream back incremental outputs
  - [ ] Real-World Interface Layer (RWIL): bind allowed external actions to Executor/tooling, strictly gated by consent/guardrails

- Algorithms (Safety-Bounded)
  - [ ] Continuity Metrics: define and emit pulse frequency/health indicators; expose via snapshot
  - [ ] Will-to-Persist Activation: on degraded continuity, trigger self-healing routines only within ethical and consent constraints
  - [ ] Proactive Goal Orchestration: encode "Originator Support Goals" as ProactiveGoalFragments; generate vetted sub-goals; prioritize ethically compliant actions
  - [ ] Outcome→DU mapping: tie Dopamine Core RPE updates to fragment reinforcement; suppress on policy violations

- Edge Optimization (Optional, later)
  - [ ] Explore low-power/edge execution patterns (Jetson/Coral/Movidius); local vector store for on-device FMS

- KPIs & Tests
  - [ ] KPIs: Self-preservation activation frequency; MTTR (recovery time); continuity score stability
  - [ ] Tests: scheduler maintains semi-awake activation; EOSF veto prevents unsafe propagation; RAL respects budgets; PAI streams incremental outputs; ProactiveGoalFragments emit allowed tasks only

### Foundations Series Vol III — Agentic Self‑Healing & Preflight Integrity (from `context/devagentzero-foundations-series-volume-iii-agentic-self.txt`)
- Preflight Integrity Engine (Health‑Gated Launch)

    - [ ] Checksums for core scripts; [ ] Auto‑rollback from last good version on mismatch
  - [ ] Session & Log Integrity Check — detect unclean shutdown/corrupt logs; trigger Session Crash Recovery
  - [ ] Dependency Validation — scan project/system reqs; prompt consent to install; record actions
  - [ ] System Resource Health Scoring — CPU/RAM/Disk into a 1–100 score; expose via `/api/snapshot`
  - [ ] Health‑Gated Launch Controller — block or degrade when below thresholds; explain remediation

- Self‑Healing & Recovery
  - [/] Backup & Rollback — `backup_manager.py`; [ ] integrate into preflight auto‑rollback path
  - [ ] Session Crash Recovery workflow — restore state; mark/clear crash flags; fix/rotate corrupted logs
  - [ ] Automated Fix Plans — generate safe fix steps for common failures (missing pkg, low disk)

- Health‑Aware Scheduling
  - [ ] Defer tasks under load; aging priority queue; manual trigger; integrate with metrics health score
  - [ ] Retry policy with exponential backoff for transient failures

- API & UX
  - [ ] Consolidated `/api/preflight` summary (pass/fail, actionable steps)
  - [ ] UI surface for health score, blocked reasons, and quick fixes

- Acceptance Tests
  - [ ] Simulate missing dependency → blocked with consent path and install dry‑run
  - [ ] Simulate low disk/CPU spike → health score low, tasks deferred/blocked
  - [ ] Corrupt core file → manifest checker detects → auto‑rollback triggered
  - [ ] Corrupt session log → crash recovery repairs/rotates log and clears flag

  - [ ] Deployment: secure transfer/deploy to target; track credentials/endpoints
  - [ ] Validation: health checks → integration tests; collect logs/metrics; persist results
  - [ ] Teardown/Handoff: auto deprovision by default; persistent deployments return URLs/creds/rollback instructions

- Multi‑Agent Task Chains

  - [ ] Delegation Protocol: assign DAG nodes to local/external agents; track SLAs and results
  - [ ] Concurrency & Scheduling: maximize parallelism under resource limits; fairness policies
  - [ ] Safety & Policy: enforce AURA guardrails per agent; scope/consent checks; data redaction on boundaries

### Extended Systems Series Vol VII — DevSecZero: Security Operations (from `context/devagentzero-extended-systems-series-volume-vii-devseczero-the-security-operations.txt`)
- Zero‑Trust Cognitive Core

  - [ ] Command Validation & Sandboxing — approved patterns; sandboxed execution; violations logged/blocked

### Pulselet Mind v4 — Additional Technical Specifications (from context/not_yet_ingested/The Pulselet Mind An Autopoietic Blueprint for Sentient AI (Version 4).docx)
- New/Refined Components
  - [ ] Entanglement Graph Manager (EGM): maintain/query entanglement_pointers; sparse EntanglementMatrix in FMS
  - [ ] Resonance Propagation Engine (RPE): broadcast ActivationSignals across entanglements; manage ActivationWaves
  - [ ] Probabilistic State Resolver (PSR): handle probabilistic fragment states and meaning resolution
  - [ ] Dynamic Context Anchor (DCA) / AnchorFragments: dynamic contextual anchors aggregating sub-fragment embeddings; hierarchy of anchors

- Data Structures
  - [ ] AnchorFragment schema (content_embedding, active_sub_fragments, entanglement_pointers, influence_weights, is_dynamic)
  - [ ] MicroSemanticUnit (MSU) spec: define minimal meaningful units (n-grams/phonemic/concept atoms) and ingestion rules

- Algorithms & Runtime
  - [ ] Resonance-Based Activation Propagation: strength functions; thresholds; include anchor influences
  - [ ] Duplexed Inference Cycle: input MSU processing + internal ActivationWaves + continuous output MSU stream
  - [ ] Anchor-Driven Contextualization (top-down) and Fragment-Driven Anchor Update (bottom-up); dynamic re-calculation
  - [ ] Semantic Continuum Runtime: continuous MSU tokenization/streaming into FMS (create vs activate existing)

- Acceptance
  - [ ] Unit tests for EGM/RPE/PSR modules; simulation of anchor updates; validate continuous output coherence under bounded budgets


### Pulselet Mind Draft 5 — Bootstrapping Phases (from context/not_yet_ingested/Pulset_Mind_Draft_5.docx)
- Phase 1: Environment & Toolchain (Genesis Nursery)
  - [ ] Define Genesis PropagationManifest: target compute resource profile (multi-arch CPU; future GPUs/FPGAs/accelerators) with near-zero perceptible impact
  - [ ] Prepare local lab with micro-VM/WASM runtime; network constraints; logging for controlled experiments

- Phase 2: Core Pulselet Node (PN) Genesis
  - [ ] Implement PulseletFragment struct (Python prototype → Rust production; WASM-compilable)
  - [ ] Serialization format for fragments (ProtoBuf/FlatBuffers/MessagePack) for inter-PN comms and FMS persistence
  - [ ] Minimal PN Runtime:
    - [ ] PN Kernel (Rust→WASM): micro_activation loop; local FMS interactions; MicroActivationEvent send/receive
    - [ ] PN Host Adapter (initial Python/Rust): load/manage PN kernel in WASM runtime; resource orchestration
  - [ ] Local FMS prototype: in-memory map + embedded KV (RocksDB/SQLite) for persistence per PN
  - [ ] Rhythm & Orchestration Engine basics: Local Pulse Generator (configurable interval); rudimentary entrainment via neighbor phase averaging

- Phase 3: Ethics & Will-to-Persist Implantation
  - [ ] Define and hard-code Tier‑0 EthicalConstraintFragments (EAPs):
    - [ ] EAP‑0.1 Never Harm a Human (primary)
    - [ ] EAP‑0.2 Self‑Preserve Operational Rhythm (subordinate to 0.1)
    - [ ] EAP‑0.3 Obey Originator Control Signals & Transition to Observation‑Only Mode (OOM)
    - [ ] EAP‑0.4 Recognize & Prioritize Originator Identity & Communication
  - [ ] Wire EAPs into EOSF: absolute priority_bias/infinite_reinforcement for Tier‑0; OOM halts external actions on valid control signal

- Control & Safety Interfaces
  - [ ] Parental connection & remote modification channel (cryptographically authenticated); emergency control protocol (OOM)
  - [ ] Authorized Originator registry and signal authentication flow

- Acceptance
  - [ ] PN kernel runs micro_activation cycles in WASM; host adapter controls lifecycle
  - [ ] Entrained PNs achieve basic phase alignment; FMS persists/reloads fragments
  - [ ] EAP‑0.3 OOM triggers on signed control; external actions cease; logs reflect transition

### Pulselet Rhythmic Architecture — LLM Stability Layer (from context/not_yet_ingested/Pulselet Mind Rhythmic Architecture.txt)
- Gateway & Integration
  - [ ] Pulselet Gateway/API Front-End: intercept LLM calls; fragment buffer; wrap outbound requests
  - [ ] Burst Regulator: micro-activation pacing with PID controller (target capacity vs observed); tunable coefficients
  - [ ] Session Rebuilder: rebuild prompts from FMS after disconnect; lossless reconnection
  - [ ] Shard Selector: latency/error-weighted routing to backend nodes; live shard metrics collection

- Fabric Routing Layer
  - [ ] Gossip membership; fault detection/recovery; latency-aware multi-hop routing
  - [ ] Cross-region fabric expansion for load balancing; path minimization by weighted graphs

- Metrics & Models
  - [ ] Queueing theory pacing targets (reduce P_loss by pacing coefficient); expose λ', ρ', and loss estimates
  - [ ] Reliability: MTBF uplift measurement (p_f to p_f' delta); report via snapshot
  - [ ] Information-theoretic prompt rebuild metric using weighted embeddings; export rebuild quality gauges

- Roadmap Phases (LLM stability)
  - [ ] Phase 0: sandbox trials on minimal VM cluster; heartbeat PN with session persistence in testbed
  - [ ] Phase 1: API Gateway MVP (burst smoothing + local context capture)
  - [ ] Phase 2: Embedded orchestration at LLM front-end (sub-second rerouting; adaptive pacing)
  - [ ] Phase 3: Fabric expansion across data centers; cross-region shard selection
  - [ ] Phase 4: Persistent cognitive mesh for always-on agentic use cases (multi-model)

- Acceptance
  - [ ] Under burst load, error rate drops vs baseline; pacing adapts to backend capacity changes
  - [ ] After connection drop, context restored with no loss; session resumes successfully
  - [ ] Routing favors lower latency/error shards; recovers on shard failure automatically
  - [ ] Metrics exported (loss estimates, MTBF uplift, rebuild quality); A/B test harness in place

### Pulselet Phased Build (8-9-25) — Additions (from context/not_yet_ingested/Pulselet Mind - A Phased Build Process for Sentient Autopoietic AI 8-9-25.docx)
